twitch.sendMessage.description: Sends a message in your Twitch chat. Empty text is skipped. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.message: What to say, like "Thanks for the follow!"
parameters.sendAs: Optional. Who sends it: "Default" (your bot account when it is signed in, otherwise you), "Bot" or "Broadcaster".

twitch.replyToMessage.description: Replies to a message in your Twitch chat, so it shows as an answer to it. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.messageId: Optional. The id of the message to answer. Leave it out for the chat message that triggered the action (%messageId%).
parameters.sendAs: Optional. Who sends it: "Default" (your bot account when it is signed in, otherwise you), "Bot" or "Broadcaster".

twitch.sendWhisper.description: Sends a private whisper to a Twitch viewer. The sending account needs a verified phone number on Twitch. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.
parameters.message: What to whisper, like "Your code is 1234".
parameters.sendAs: Optional. Who sends it: "Default" (your bot account when it is signed in, otherwise you), "Bot" or "Broadcaster".

twitch.sendAnnouncement.description: Posts an announcement in your Twitch chat: a highlighted message with a coloured bar. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.message: What to announce, like "Giveaway starts in 5 minutes!"
parameters.color: Optional. "primary" (your channel colour, the default), "blue", "green", "orange" or "purple".

twitch.deleteMessage.description: Deletes one message from your Twitch chat. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.messageId: Optional. The id of the message. Leave it out for the chat message that triggered the action (%messageId%).

twitch.clearChat.description: Clears every message from your Twitch chat. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

twitch.getPresentViewers.description: Gets the people in your Twitch chat right now. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getPresentViewers.returns: An object with presentViewerCount and presentViewers (their login names, separated by commas).

twitch.pinMessage.description: Pins a message at the top of your Twitch chat. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.messageId: Optional. The id of the message. Leave it out for the chat message that triggered the action (%messageId%).
parameters.duration: Optional. How long to keep it pinned, in seconds (30 to 1800). Leave it out (or 0) to keep it until the stream ends.

twitch.unpinMessage.description: Unpins a message in your Twitch chat. Fails when nothing is pinned. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.messageId: Optional. The id of the pinned message. Leave it out for the message pinned now.

twitch.updatePinnedDuration.description: Changes how long the pinned message stays pinned, counting from now. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.messageId: Optional. The id of the pinned message. Leave it out for the message pinned now.
parameters.duration: Optional. Seconds from now (30 to 1800). 0 keeps it until the stream ends. Leave it out for 60.

twitch.getPinnedMessage.description: Gets the message pinned in your Twitch chat right now. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getPinnedMessage.returns: An object with isPinned, pinnedMessage, pinnedMessageId, pinnedUser, pinnedUserName, pinnedUserId, pinnedBy, pinnedAt and pinnedUntil. Text values are empty when nothing is pinned.

twitch.sendAndPinMessage.description: Sends a message in your Twitch chat as yourself (not the bot) and pins it right away. Fails when the message is empty. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.message: What to say and pin, like "Giveaway: type !join"
parameters.duration: Optional. How long to keep it pinned, in seconds. Leave it out (or 0) to keep it until the stream ends.

twitch.sendAndPinMessage.returns: The id of the new message.

twitch.setTitle.description: Changes the title of your Twitch stream. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.title: The new title, like "Chill games with chat".

twitch.setGame.description: Changes the category (game) of your Twitch stream. It picks the exact name, or else the best search match. Fails when nothing matches. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.game: The category or game name, like "Just Chatting".

twitch.setGame.returns: An object with gameId, gameName, gameBoxArt and gameSuccess (true).

twitch.setTags.description: Replaces all tags of your Twitch channel. Twitch allows at most 10. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.tags: The tags as text, separated by commas or spaces, like "English, Chill, Cozy".

twitch.addTag.description: Adds one tag to your Twitch channel. Your other tags stay. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

twitch.removeTag.description: Removes one tag from your Twitch channel. Upper or lower case and a leading # do not matter. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

twitch.clearTags.description: Removes every tag from your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

twitch.setBrandedContent.description: Turns the branded content (sponsored stream) label on your Twitch channel on or off. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.enabled: Optional. true turns it on, false turns it off. Leave it out for true.

twitch.setContentLabel.description: Turns one content warning label on your Twitch channel on or off, like "Strong language". Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.label: Optional. "DrugsIntoxication", "SexualThemes", "ViolentGraphic", "Gambling" or "ProfanityVulgarity" (strong language, the default).
parameters.enabled: Optional. true turns it on, false turns it off. Leave it out for true.

twitch.updateStreamInfo.description: Changes the title, category and tags of your Twitch stream in one go. Anything you leave empty stays as it is. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.title: Optional. The new title. Leave it empty to keep it.
parameters.game: Optional. The new category or game name, like "Minecraft". Leave it empty to keep it.
parameters.tags: Optional. New tags as text, separated by commas, like "English, Chill". Leave it empty to keep them.

twitch.getChannelInfo.description: Gets a Twitch channel's details: title, category, tags and more. Fails when the channel is not found. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A channel's login name or "id:12345". Leave it out for your own channel.

twitch.getChannelInfo.returns: An object with channelId, channelUser, channelUserName, channelTitle, channelGame, channelGameId, channelTags, channelLanguage, channelContentLabels and channelIsBrandedContent.

twitch.getStreamInfo.description: Checks whether a Twitch channel is live, with its viewers, title and uptime. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A channel's login name or "id:12345". Leave it out for your own channel.

twitch.getStreamInfo.returns: An object with isLive, viewerCount, streamTitle, streamGame, streamStartedAt and uptimeSeconds. Values are empty or 0 when the channel is offline.

twitch.createMarker.description: Adds a stream marker at this moment, so you can find it again later in your video. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.description: Optional. A short note for the marker, like "Epic win".

twitch.createMarker.returns: An object with markerId, markerPosition (seconds into the stream), streamMarkerSuccess, streamMarkerId, streamMarkerCreatedAt, streamMarkerDescription and streamMarkerPosition.

twitch.createClip.description: Makes a clip of your live Twitch stream. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.hasDelay: Optional. true makes the clip account for your stream delay. Leave it out for false.
parameters.title: Optional. The clip's title. Leave it out to use your stream title.
parameters.duration: Optional. The clip's length in seconds, 5 to 60. Leave it out for Twitch's 30 seconds.

twitch.createClip.returns: An object with clipId, clipEditUrl, clipUrl, createClipSuccess, createClipId, createClipCreatedAt and createClipUrl.

twitch.getClipDownloadUrls.description: Gets download links for clips of your channel. Twitch's links only work for a short time. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.clipId: Optional. The clip id, or up to 10 ids separated by commas. Leave it out for %clipId% (for example from twitch.createClip).

twitch.getClipDownloadUrls.returns: An object with clipDownloadCount, clipDownloadUrl, clipLandscapeDownloadUrl and clipPortraitDownloadUrl (of the first clip), plus clipDownload0.clipId, clipDownload0.landscapeUrl and so on.

twitch.getClips.description: Lists clips of a Twitch channel or of a category, most viewed first. Handy for a clip player. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A channel's login name or "id:12345". Leave it (and gameId) out for your own channel.
parameters.gameId: Optional. A category id, to get that category's clips instead of a channel's.
parameters.startedAt: Optional. Only clips made after this date and time, like "2026-10-01T00:00:00Z".
parameters.endedAt: Optional. Only clips made before this date and time.
parameters.count: Optional. How many clips at most. Leave it out (or 0) for up to 1000.
parameters.featured: Optional. true gives only featured clips, false only the others. Leave it out for all.

twitch.getClips.returns: A list of clips, each with id, url, embedUrl, broadcasterName, creatorName, title, viewCount, createdAt, thumbnailUrl, duration, isFeatured and more.

twitch.runAd.description: Starts an ad break on your Twitch stream right now. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.length: Optional. How long, in seconds: 30, 60, 90, 120, 150 or 180. Leave it out for 30.

twitch.runAd.returns: An object with adLength and adRetryAfter (seconds until you can run another one).

twitch.snoozeAd.description: Pushes your next scheduled Twitch ad back, if you have snoozes left. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.snoozeAd.returns: An object with snooze.success, nextAdAt, lastAdAt, adDuration, prerollFreeTime, snoozeCount, snoozeRefreshAt, prerollFree and prerollFreeSeconds.

twitch.getAdSchedule.description: Gets your Twitch ad schedule: when the next ad comes and how many snoozes you have. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getAdSchedule.returns: An object with nextAdAt, lastAdAt, adDuration, prerollFreeTime, snoozeCount, snoozeRefreshAt, prerollFree and prerollFreeSeconds.

twitch.startRaid.description: Starts a raid to another Twitch channel. Fails when the channel is not found. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.cancelRaid.description: Stops the raid you started, before it goes. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

twitch.sendShoutout.description: Sends an official Twitch shoutout to another channel, so your viewers can follow them with one click. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.ban.description: Bans a viewer from your Twitch chat for good. Fails when the user is not found. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.ban.returns: An object with bannedUser (display name), bannedUserName (login), bannedUserId, bannedUserType ("twitch") and banResult (true).

twitch.timeout.description: Times out a viewer in your Twitch chat, so they cannot chat for a while. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.
parameters.duration: Optional. How long, in seconds (1 second to 14 days). Leave it out for 600 (10 minutes).

twitch.timeout.returns: An object with timedOutUser (display name), timedOutUserName (login), timedOutUserId, timedOutUserType ("twitch") and timeoutResult (true).

twitch.unban.description: Lets a banned viewer chat in your Twitch channel again. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.unban.returns: An object with unbannedUser (display name), unbannedUserName (login), unbannedUserId, unbannedUserType ("twitch") and unbanResult (true).

twitch.untimeout.description: Ends a viewer's timeout early, so they can chat again. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.untimeout.returns: An object with unTimedOutUser (display name), unTimedOutUserName (login), unTimedOutUserId, unTimedOutUserType ("twitch") and unTimedOutResult (true).

twitch.warn.description: Sends a viewer an official Twitch warning. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.
parameters.reason: The warning text they will see, like "Please keep it friendly".

twitch.warn.returns: An object with warnedUser (display name), warnedUserName (login), warnedUserId, warnedUserType ("twitch") and warnedResult (true).

twitch.addSuspiciousStatus.description: Marks a viewer as suspicious. "Active Monitoring" flags their messages for your mods; "Restricted" keeps their messages out of chat. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.addSuspiciousStatus.returns: An object with suspiciousUser, suspiciousUserName, suspiciousUserId, suspiciousUserType, suspiciousStatusResult, suspiciousStatus (like "RESTRICTED") and suspiciousTypes.

twitch.removeSuspiciousStatus.description: Removes the suspicious mark from a viewer, so their messages show normally again. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.removeSuspiciousStatus.returns: An object with suspiciousUser, suspiciousUserName, suspiciousUserId, suspiciousUserType, suspiciousStatusResult and suspiciousStatus ("NO_TREATMENT").

twitch.addVip.description: Makes a viewer a VIP in your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.removeVip.description: Takes VIP away from a viewer in your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.addModerator.description: Makes a viewer a moderator in your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.removeModerator.description: Takes moderator away from a viewer in your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.emoteOnly.description: Turns emote-only chat on or off: viewers can only send emotes. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.enabled: Optional. true turns it on, false turns it off. Leave it out for true.

twitch.followerMode.description: Turns follower-only chat on or off: only followers can chat, optionally after following for some minutes. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.enabled: Optional. true turns it on, false turns it off. Leave it out for true.
parameters.minutes: Optional. How long someone must have followed, in minutes (0 to 129600, which is 3 months). Leave it out for 0.

twitch.slowMode.description: Turns slow mode on or off: viewers must wait between messages. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.enabled: Optional. true turns it on, false turns it off. Leave it out for true.
parameters.seconds: Optional. The wait between messages, in seconds (3 to 120). Leave it out for 30.

twitch.subscriberMode.description: Turns subscriber-only chat on or off. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.enabled: Optional. true turns it on, false turns it off. Leave it out for true.

twitch.uniqueChat.description: Turns unique chat on or off: viewers cannot post the same message twice in a row. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.enabled: Optional. true turns it on, false turns it off. Leave it out for true.

twitch.setShieldMode.description: Turns Twitch Shield Mode on or off. It locks chat down quickly during a hate raid. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.enabled: Optional. true turns Shield Mode on, false turns it off. Leave it out for true.

twitch.getShieldMode.description: Checks whether Twitch Shield Mode is on. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getShieldMode.returns: An object with shieldModeActive and shieldModeModerator (who turned it on).

twitch.addBlockedTerm.description: Adds a word or phrase to your Twitch blocked terms, so messages with it are hidden. Fails when the term is empty. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.term: The word or phrase to block, like "buy followers".

twitch.removeBlockedTerm.description: Removes a word or phrase from your Twitch blocked terms. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.term: The blocked text (upper or lower case does not matter) or its id.

twitch.removeBlockedTerm.returns: true when it was removed, false when the channel has no such blocked term.

twitch.getBlockedTerms.description: Lists every blocked word or phrase of your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getBlockedTerms.returns: A list, each with id and text.

twitch.resolveAutomod.description: Allows or denies a chat message that AutoMod held back. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.messageId: Optional. The id of the held message. Leave it out for %messageId% of the AutoMod trigger.
parameters.decision: Optional. "Allow" (the default) shows the message; "Deny" throws it away. Capital letters do not matter.

twitch.getModerators.description: Lists every moderator of your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getModerators.returns: A list, each with userId, userLogin and userName.

twitch.getVips.description: Lists every VIP of your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getVips.returns: A list, each with userId, userLogin and userName.

twitch.createPoll.description: Starts a Twitch poll in your chat with 2 to 5 choices. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.title: The question, like "Which game next?"
parameters.choices: The answers as text, one per line or separated by |, like "Minecraft|Fortnite|Tetris".
parameters.duration: Optional. How long the poll runs, in seconds (15 to 1800). Leave it out for 60.
parameters.pointsPerVote: Optional. Channel points for each extra vote. Leave it out (or 0) to turn extra votes off.

twitch.createPoll.returns: An object with pollId and success (true).

twitch.endPoll.description: Ends the running Twitch poll early. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.mode: Optional. "Terminate" (the default) ends it and shows the results; "Archive" ends it and hides them. Capital letters do not matter.

twitch.getPoll.description: Gets your latest Twitch poll and its votes. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getPoll.returns: An object with pollId, pollTitle, pollStatus, pollIsActive, pollChoiceCount, pollChoice0, pollChoice0Votes and so on, active, plus poll.Title, poll.votes and more.

twitch.createPrediction.description: Starts a Twitch prediction: viewers bet channel points on 2 to 10 outcomes. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.title: The question, like "Will I beat the boss?"
parameters.outcomes: The outcomes as text, one per line or separated by |, like "Yes|No".
parameters.window: Optional. How long viewers can bet, in seconds (30 to 1800). Leave it out for 120.

twitch.createPrediction.returns: An object with predictionId, prediction.Id and success (true).

twitch.lockPrediction.description: Stops new bets on the running Twitch prediction. The result is decided later. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.lockPrediction.returns: An object with locked (true), active and the prediction's details: prediction.Id, prediction.Title, prediction.outcome0.title and so on.

twitch.cancelPrediction.description: Cancels the running Twitch prediction and gives everyone their points back. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.cancelPrediction.returns: An object with cancelled (true), active and the prediction's details: prediction.Id, prediction.Title, prediction.outcome0.title and so on.

twitch.resolvePrediction.description: Picks the winning outcome of your Twitch prediction and pays out the points. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.winner: The winning outcome: its title, like "Yes", or its number (1, 2, ...).
parameters.title: Optional. Only resolve a prediction with this title. Leave it out for the latest prediction.

twitch.resolvePrediction.returns: An object with success (true), the prediction's details (prediction.Id, prediction.Title, prediction.outcome0.title and so on) and prediction.winningOutcome.title, .users and .points.

twitch.getPrediction.description: Gets your latest Twitch prediction and its bets. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getPrediction.returns: An object with predictionId, predictionTitle, predictionStatus, predictionOutcomeCount, predictionOutcome0, predictionOutcome0Users, predictionOutcome0Points and so on, active, plus prediction.* details.

twitch.getRewards.description: Lists every channel point reward of your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getRewards.returns: A list of rewards, each with id, title, prompt, cost, backgroundColor, isEnabled, isPaused, isInStock, maxPerStream, globalCooldownSeconds, isManageable (true when Cuebot can change it) and more.

twitch.createReward.description: Makes a new channel point reward. Cuebot can change it later because it made it. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.title: The reward name, like "Hydrate!"
parameters.cost: Optional. The price in channel points. Leave it out for 100.
parameters.prompt: Optional. The text viewers see under the title.
parameters.inputRequired: Optional. true makes viewers type a message when they redeem. Leave it out for false.
parameters.enabled: Optional. false makes it hidden at first. Leave it out for true.

twitch.setRewardEnabled.description: Turns a channel point reward on or off. A turned-off reward is hidden from viewers. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.
parameters.enabled: Optional. true shows it, false hides it. Leave it out for true.

twitch.setRewardPaused.description: Pauses or unpauses a channel point reward. Viewers see a paused reward but cannot redeem it. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.
parameters.paused: Optional. true pauses it, false unpauses it. Leave it out for true.

twitch.setRewardCost.description: Changes the price of a channel point reward. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.
parameters.cost: Optional. The new price in channel points. Leave it out for 100.

twitch.setRewardTitle.description: Changes the name of a channel point reward. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.
parameters.title: The new name, like "Drink water!".

twitch.setRewardPrompt.description: Changes the text viewers see under a channel point reward. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.
parameters.prompt: The new text, like "Make me drink some water".

twitch.setRewardColor.description: Changes the background colour of a channel point reward. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.
parameters.color: Optional. The colour as #RRGGBB, like "#FF6600". Leave it out for Twitch purple (#9147FF).
parameters.random: Optional. true picks a random colour instead. Leave it out for false.

twitch.setRewardCooldown.description: Sets how long everyone must wait between redeems of a channel point reward. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.
parameters.seconds: Optional. The wait in seconds, like 60. 0 (the default) turns the cooldown off.

twitch.setRewardMaxPerStream.description: Sets how many times a channel point reward can be redeemed per stream, by everyone together. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.
parameters.max: Optional. The limit, like 10. 0 (the default) removes the limit.
parameters.additive: Optional. true adds max to the current limit (a negative number lowers it) instead of replacing it. Leave it out for false.

twitch.setRewardMaxPerUser.description: Sets how many times each viewer can redeem a channel point reward per stream. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.
parameters.max: Optional. The limit, like 1. 0 (the default) removes the limit.
parameters.additive: Optional. true adds max to the current limit (a negative number lowers it) instead of replacing it. Leave it out for false.

twitch.deleteReward.description: Deletes a channel point reward for good. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.

twitch.getRewardInfo.description: Gets the settings of one channel point reward. Fails when no reward matches. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.

twitch.getRewardInfo.returns: An object with rewardId, rewardTitle, rewardPrompt, rewardCost, rewardEnabled, rewardPaused, rewardInStock, rewardBackgroundColor, rewardCooldown, rewardMaxPerStream, rewardMaxPerUser, rewardIsManageable and more.

twitch.updateRedemption.description: Marks a channel point redemption as done, or cancels it and gives the points back. Only works for rewards Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.rewardId: Optional. The reward id. Leave it out for %rewardId% of the redemption trigger.
parameters.redemptionId: Optional. The redemption id. Leave it out for %redemptionId% of the redemption trigger.
parameters.status: Optional. "Fulfil" (the default) marks it done; "Cancel" refunds the points. Capital letters do not matter.

twitch.updateReward.description: Changes the name, text and price of a channel point reward in one go. Empty values stay as they are. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.
parameters.title: Optional. The new name. Leave it empty to keep it.
parameters.prompt: Optional. The new text. Leave it empty to keep it.
parameters.cost: Optional. A number. With "Set" it becomes the new price; with the other operators it changes the current price (never below 1).

twitch.updateReward.returns: An object with rewardCost (the price now).

twitch.getRewardCounter.description: Tells you how often a channel point reward was redeemed, in total and by one viewer. Cuebot counts these itself. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.
parameters.user: Optional. The viewer to count: a login name or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.getRewardCounter.returns: An object with counter (all redeems) and userCounter (that viewer's redeems).

twitch.getRewardUserCounters.description: Tells you how often each viewer redeemed a channel point reward, as Cuebot counted it. Fails when no reward matches. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate!".

twitch.getRewardUserCounters.returns: An object with each viewer's user id and their count, like { "12345": 3 }.

twitch.resetRewardCounter.description: Sets the total redeem count of a channel point reward back to 0. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.

twitch.resetRewardUserCounters.description: Sets every viewer's redeem count of a channel point reward back to 0. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed.

twitch.resetUserRewardCounter.description: Sets one viewer's redeem count of one channel point reward back to 0. Fails when the reward or the user is not found. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.reward: The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate!".
parameters.user: A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345", like "coolviewer42".

twitch.resetUserRewardCounters.description: Sets one viewer's redeem counts of every channel point reward back to 0. Fails when the user is not found. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345", like "coolviewer42".

twitch.setRewardGroupEnabled.description: Turns every reward in a reward group on or off at once. Rewards Cuebot did not make are skipped. Fails when the group has no rewards. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.group: The reward group name, as set on the Twitch page (Rewards tab), like "Games".
parameters.state: Optional. "Enabled" (the default), "Disabled" or "Toggle" (on, unless one of them is already on).

twitch.setRewardGroupEnabled.returns: An object with rewardsChanged and rewardsSkipped (rewards Cuebot could not change).

twitch.setRewardGroupPaused.description: Pauses or unpauses every reward in a reward group at once. Rewards Cuebot did not make are skipped. Fails when the group has no rewards. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.group: The reward group name, as set on the Twitch page (Rewards tab), like "Games".
parameters.state: Optional. "Paused" (the default), "Unpaused" or "Toggle" (paused, unless one of them is already paused).

twitch.setRewardGroupPaused.returns: An object with rewardsChanged and rewardsSkipped (rewards Cuebot could not change).

twitch.configureRewards.description: Turns many channel point rewards on, off, paused or unpaused in one go. Fails when a name matches no reward or group. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.enable: Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by |.
parameters.disable: Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by |.
parameters.pause: Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by |.
parameters.unpause: Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by |.
parameters.disableNotConfigured: Optional. true also turns off every reward that is in no reward group. Leave it out for false.

twitch.configureRewards.returns: An object with rewardsChanged and rewardsSkipped (rewards Cuebot could not change).

twitch.getUser.description: Looks up a Twitch user. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345", like "coolviewer42".

twitch.getUser.returns: An object with id, login, displayName, type, broadcasterType, description, profileImageUrl, offlineImageUrl and createdAt. null when the user is not found.

twitch.getUserInfo.description: Gets lots of details about a Twitch user: profile, account age, mod/VIP/sub status and their channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.getUserInfo.returns: An object with targetFound, targetUser, targetUserName, targetUserId, targetDescription, targetProfileImageUrl, targetCreatedAt, targetAccountAgeDays, targetIsModerator, targetIsVip, targetGame, targetTitle and more.

twitch.getFollowAge.description: Tells you if and how long a viewer has followed your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.getFollowAge.returns: An object with isFollowing, followedAt, followAgeDays, followAge (like "2 years, 3 months"), followDate, followAgeLong, followAgeShort, followAge.years and more.

twitch.getSubStatus.description: Checks whether a viewer subscribes to your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.getSubStatus.returns: An object with isSubscribed, subTier, subIsGift and subGifter.

twitch.getFollowerCount.description: Gets how many followers your Twitch channel has, and who followed last. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getFollowerCount.returns: An object with followerCount, latestFollower, latestFollowerUserName and latestFollowerUserId.

twitch.getSubscriberCount.description: Gets how many subscribers your Twitch channel has. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getSubscriberCount.returns: An object with subscriberCount and subPoints.

twitch.getLatestSubscriber.description: Tells you who subscribed last, as Cuebot saw it.
twitch.getLatestSubscriber.returns: An object with latestSubscriber.userName, latestSubscriber.userLogin, latestSubscriber.userId, latestSubscriber.tier (like "Tier1"), latestSubscriber.isGift and latestSubscriber.at.

twitch.getSubCounter.description: Reads Cuebot's sub counter, for a sub goal or sub train.
twitch.getSubCounter.returns: An object with subCounter.count, subCounter.rollover and subCounter.rolloverCount.

twitch.setSubCounter.description: Sets Cuebot's sub counter to a number, for example to start a new sub goal.

parameters.count: Optional. The new count, a whole number of 0 or more. Leave it out for 0.
parameters.rolloverCount: Optional. The new rollover count. Leave it out to keep it.

twitch.setSubCounter.returns: An object with setResult (false when count is not a valid number) and, when it worked, subCounter.count, subCounter.rollover and subCounter.rolloverCount.

twitch.getPresentUser.description: Gets one person in your Twitch chat by their number in the list. Handy with a random number. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.index: Optional. The number, starting at 0 for the first person. Leave it out for 0.

twitch.getPresentUser.returns: An object with presentUsersCount, presentUser (their name, or false when the number is too big), presentUserId, presentUserName and presentUserType.

twitch.getRandomUsers.description: Picks random people from your Twitch chat. Handy for giveaways. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.count: Optional. How many to pick. Leave it out for 1.
parameters.excludeBroadcaster: Optional. true (the default) leaves you and your bot out; false lets them be picked.

twitch.getRandomUsers.returns: An object with randomUserCount, and randomUser0, randomUserName0, randomUserId0, randomUserType0 for the first pick, and so on.

twitch.getTeamInfo.description: Gets the Twitch teams a channel belongs to. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.

twitch.getTeamInfo.returns: An object with teamCount, teams (names, separated by commas) and teamName (the first team).

twitch.getBroadcasterInfo.description: Gets details about your own Twitch account, like partner or affiliate status. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getBroadcasterInfo.returns: An object with broadcasterUserId, broadcasterUserName, broadcasterUser, broadcasterType, broadcasterIsAffiliate, broadcasterIsPartner, broadcasterProfileImageUrl, broadcasterDescription, botUserId, botUserName and more.

twitch.getBroadcaster.description: Gives you your signed-in Twitch account as Cuebot knows it. Works without asking Twitch.
twitch.getBroadcaster.returns: An object with userId, userName, connected (true when Twitch is connected) and scopes (the permissions you gave).

twitch.getBot.description: Gives you your Twitch bot account, as set on the Twitch page. Works without asking Twitch.
twitch.getBot.returns: An object with userId, userName and connected. null when no bot account is signed in.

twitch.getCharityCampaign.description: Gets your running Twitch charity campaign. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getCharityCampaign.returns: An object with charityActive, charityName, charityCurrent, charityTarget and charityCurrency. Values are empty when no campaign runs.

twitch.getCheermotes.description: Lists the Bits cheer emotes (cheermotes) that work in your channel, exactly as Twitch gives them. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getCheermotes.returns: A list of cheermotes in Twitch's own format (each with prefix, tiers and image links).

twitch.getGuestStarSettings.description: Gets your Twitch Guest Star settings. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getGuestStarSettings.returns: An object with guestStarSlotCount, guestStarLayout, guestStarModeratorSendLive, guestStarBrowserSourceAudio and guestStarBrowserSourceToken.

twitch.updateGuestStarSettings.description: Changes your Twitch Guest Star settings. Anything left at its default stays as it is. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.slotCount: Optional. How many guest slots, 1 to 6. Leave it out (or 0) to keep it.
parameters.moderatorSendLive: Optional. Whether moderators can send guests live: "On", "Off" or "Keep" (the default).
parameters.browserSourceAudio: Optional. Whether the browser sources play audio: "On", "Off" or "Keep" (the default).
parameters.regenerateBrowserSources: Optional. true makes new browser source links; the old ones stop working. Leave it out for false.

twitch.getGuestStarSession.description: Gets your running Twitch Guest Star session and its guests. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getGuestStarSession.returns: An object with guestStarActive, guestStarSessionId, guestStarGuestCount, and guestStarGuest0, guestStarGuest0UserName, guestStarGuest0UserId, guestStarGuest0Slot, guestStarGuest0IsLive, guestStarGuest0Volume and so on.

twitch.createGuestStarSession.description: Starts a Twitch Guest Star session. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.createGuestStarSession.returns: An object with guestStarActive, guestStarSessionId, guestStarGuestCount, and guestStarGuest0, guestStarGuest0UserName, guestStarGuest0UserId, guestStarGuest0Slot, guestStarGuest0IsLive, guestStarGuest0Volume and so on.

twitch.endGuestStarSession.description: Ends a Twitch Guest Star session. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.sessionId: Optional. The Guest Star session id. Leave it out for the session running now.

twitch.getGuestStarInvites.description: Lists the people invited to your Twitch Guest Star session. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.sessionId: Optional. The Guest Star session id. Leave it out for the session running now.

twitch.getGuestStarInvites.returns: An object with guestStarInviteCount, guestStarInvites (user ids, separated by commas), and guestStarInvite0UserId, guestStarInvite0Status and so on.

twitch.sendGuestStarInvite.description: Invites a viewer to your Twitch Guest Star session. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.
parameters.sessionId: Optional. The Guest Star session id. Leave it out for the session running now.

twitch.deleteGuestStarInvite.description: Takes back a viewer's Twitch Guest Star invite. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.
parameters.sessionId: Optional. The Guest Star session id. Leave it out for the session running now.

twitch.assignGuestStarSlot.description: Puts an invited guest into a Twitch Guest Star slot. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.
parameters.slot: Optional. The slot number, from 1 up to the number of slots, like "2". Leave it out for 1.
parameters.sessionId: Optional. The Guest Star session id. Leave it out for the session running now.

twitch.updateGuestStarSlot.description: Moves a Twitch Guest Star guest from one slot to another. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.slot: Optional. The slot the guest is in now, like "1". Leave it out for 1.
parameters.toSlot: Optional. The slot to move them to, like "3". Leave it out for 1.
parameters.sessionId: Optional. The Guest Star session id. Leave it out for the session running now.

twitch.deleteGuestStarSlot.description: Removes a guest from their Twitch Guest Star slot. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action.
parameters.slot: Optional. The slot number, from 1 up to the number of slots, like "2". Leave it out for 1.
parameters.reinvite: Optional. true sends them back to the invite list. Leave it out for false.
parameters.sessionId: Optional. The Guest Star session id. Leave it out for the session running now.

twitch.updateGuestStarSlotSettings.description: Changes audio, video, live state or volume of one Twitch Guest Star slot. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.slot: Optional. The slot number, from 1 up to the number of slots, like "2". Leave it out for 1.
parameters.audio: Optional. The guest's audio: "On", "Off" or "Keep" (the default, leaves it as it is).
parameters.video: Optional. The guest's video: "On", "Off" or "Keep" (the default, leaves it as it is).
parameters.live: Optional. Whether the guest is live on stream: "On", "Off" or "Keep" (the default, leaves it as it is).
parameters.volume: Optional. Volume from 0 to 100. Leave it out (or -1) to keep it.
parameters.sessionId: Optional. The Guest Star session id. Leave it out for the session running now.

twitch.createClipFromVod.description: Clips a moment that already happened, from your current or a past broadcast. Use it for "clip the last 2 minutes" style commands. Twitch only allows this when past broadcasts are stored on your channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.title: Optional. The clip's title. Twitch requires one.
parameters.secondsAgo: Optional. When no video id is given: how many seconds ago the clip should end, counted back from now in the current broadcast. 0 ends it now.
parameters.duration: Optional. How long the clip is, in seconds, from 5 to 60.
parameters.videoId: Optional. The video to clip. Leave empty for your current (or latest) broadcast.
parameters.endOffset: Optional. With a video id: where the clip ends, in seconds from the start of the video.

twitch.createClipFromVod.returns: An object with clipId, clipUrl, clipEditUrl and clipVideoId.

twitch.getVideos.description: Looks up the newest videos of a channel: past broadcasts, highlights or uploads. Handy for shoutouts ("check out their last stream"). Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. The channel, as a login name or id:12345. Leave empty for your own channel.
parameters.type: Optional. Past broadcasts (archive), highlights, uploads, or all of them.
parameters.count: Optional. How many videos to get, newest first (1 to 100).

twitch.getVideos.returns: An object with videoCount, videoTitle, videoUrl, videoCreatedAt, videoDuration, videoViews and video0.title.

twitch.searchChannels.description: Searches Twitch for channels by name. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.query: Optional. The name, or part of it, to search for.
parameters.liveOnly: Optional. Tick to find only channels that are live right now.
parameters.count: Optional. How many results to get (1 to 100).

twitch.searchChannels.returns: An object with channelCount, channel0.login, channel0.name, channel0.isLive, channel0.title, channel0.gameName and channel0.startedAt.

twitch.getStreamMarkers.description: Lists the stream markers of your current (or latest) broadcast. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.count: Optional. How many markers to get (1 to 100).

twitch.getStreamMarkers.returns: An object with markerCount, marker0.description, marker0.position, marker0.url and marker0.id.

twitch.getHypeTrain.description: Checks whether a Hype Train is running right now and how far it is, plus your channel's record. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getHypeTrain.returns: An object with hypeTrainActive, hypeTrainLevel, hypeTrainProgress, hypeTrainGoal, hypeTrainPercent, hypeTrainTotal, hypeTrainType, hypeTrainExpiresAt, hypeTrainIsShared, hypeTrainTopContributor, hypeTrainTopContribution, hypeTrainRecordLevel, hypeTrainRecordTotal, hypeTrainRecordAt and hypeTrainId.

twitch.getCreatorGoals.description: Lists the creator goals you have running on Twitch, like a follower or sub goal. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getCreatorGoals.returns: An object with goalCount, goal0.type, goal0.description, goal0.current, goal0.target and goal0.id.

twitch.getBitsLeaderboard.description: Gets your top cheerers for a day, week, month, year or all time. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.count: Optional. How many people to get (1 to 100).
parameters.period: Optional. The time span: all time, or the current day, week, month or year.

twitch.getBitsLeaderboard.returns: An object with leaderCount, leader0.user, leader0.userName, leader0.userId, leader0.score and leader0.rank.

twitch.getCustomPowerUps.description: Lists your channel's custom Power-ups (the ones viewers buy with Bits). Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getCustomPowerUps.returns: An object with powerUpCount, powerUp0.title, powerUp0.bits, powerUp0.enabled, powerUp0.paused, powerUp0.id and powerUp0.image.

twitch.getCharityDonations.description: Lists the donations to your running charity campaign. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.count: Optional. How many donations to get (1 to 100).

twitch.getCharityDonations.returns: An object with donationCount, donation0.user, donation0.userName, donation0.amount and donation0.currency.

twitch.getUnbanRequests.description: Lists unban requests: people who were banned and asked to be let back in. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.status: Optional. Which requests: pending (not answered yet), approved, denied, acknowledged or canceled.

twitch.getUnbanRequests.returns: An object with unbanRequestCount, unbanRequest0.id, unbanRequest0.user, unbanRequest0.userName, unbanRequest0.userId, unbanRequest0.text and unbanRequest0.createdAt.

twitch.resolveUnbanRequest.description: Approves or denies an unban request. Approving lets the person chat again. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.requestId: Optional. The request to answer. The Unban request created trigger and Get unban requests give you this id.
parameters.decision: Optional. Approve lets them back in; deny keeps the ban.
parameters.message: Optional. An optional note the person sees, up to 500 characters.

twitch.getBanStatus.description: Checks whether someone is banned or timed out in your chat. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. Login name (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty for the person who triggered the action.

twitch.getBanStatus.returns: An object with isBanned, isTimedOut, banReason, bannedAt, timeoutEndsAt and bannedBy.

twitch.getAutomodSettings.description: Reads how strict AutoMod is in your chat, from 0 (off) to 4 (strictest) for each kind of message. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getAutomodSettings.returns: An object with automodLevel, automodAggression, automodBullying, automodDisability, automodMisogyny, automodRaceEthnicityOrReligion, automodSexBasedTerms, automodSexualitySexOrGender and automodSwearing.

twitch.setAutomodLevel.description: Sets how strict AutoMod is for every kind of message at once. For example, turn it up when a raid arrives. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.level: Optional. 0 turns AutoMod off; 4 holds the most messages for review.

twitch.blockUser.description: Blocks someone for your Twitch account, so they cannot whisper you or appear in your chat. Needs the Block users permission on the Twitch Settings tab. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. Login name (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty for the person who triggered the action.

twitch.unblockUser.description: Unblocks someone you blocked before. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.user: Optional. Login name (a leading @ is fine) or id:12345. Leave empty for the person who triggered the action.

twitch.getSchedule.description: Reads your Twitch stream schedule, for example to answer a !schedule command. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.count: Optional. How many upcoming streams to get (1 to 25).

twitch.getSchedule.returns: An object with nextStreamAt, nextStreamAtLocal, nextStreamTitle, nextStreamCategory, scheduleCount, schedule0.title, onVacation, vacationStart and vacationEnd.

twitch.addScheduleSegment.description: Adds a stream to your Twitch schedule. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.start: Optional. When it starts, like 2026-12-01 19:00, in this computer's time zone.
parameters.duration: Optional. How long it runs, in minutes (30 to 1380).
parameters.title: Optional. The stream's title, up to 140 characters.
parameters.category: Optional. A category name or id. Leave empty for none.
parameters.recurring: Optional. Tick to repeat it every week.

twitch.cancelScheduleSegment.description: Cancels one scheduled stream (it stays on the schedule, marked cancelled), or brings it back. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.segmentId: Optional. The scheduled stream's id, from Get stream schedule or Add to stream schedule.
parameters.canceled: Optional. Tick to cancel it; untick to bring it back.

twitch.deleteScheduleSegment.description: Removes a stream from your schedule. For a weekly stream this removes every week. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.segmentId: Optional. The scheduled stream's id, from Get stream schedule or Add to stream schedule.

twitch.setVacation.description: Turns schedule vacation on or off. While on, the streams in that time are hidden from your schedule. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.enabled: Optional. Tick to go on vacation; untick to end it.
parameters.start: Optional. When the vacation starts, like 2026-12-20 00:00. Needed when turning it on.
parameters.end: Optional. When it ends. Needed when turning it on.

twitch.getSharedChatSession.description: Checks whether your chat is shared with other channels right now (Shared Chat). Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getSharedChatSession.returns: An object with sharedChatActive, sharedChatIsHost, sharedChatParticipantCount, sharedChatParticipantIds, sharedChatHostId and sharedChatSessionId.

twitch.getEmotes.description: Lists Twitch emotes with their images: your channel's own, Twitch's global ones, or the emotes of emote sets. Handy for emote walls. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.setIds: Optional. With source "set": emote set ids separated by commas (up to 25).

twitch.getEmotes.returns: A list of emotes, each with id, name, type, tier, setId, isAnimated and imageUrl.

twitch.getChatColors.description: Gets the name colors people use in Twitch chat. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

parameters.users: Login names or "id:12345", separated by commas (up to 100).

twitch.getChatColors.returns: An object from user id to color, like #FF7F50. The color is empty for someone who never picked one.

twitch.getContentLabels.description: Lists Twitch's content classification labels, such as Gambling or Mature-rated game, with their ids. Use an id with Set content label. Fails when Twitch is not connected.
twitch.getContentLabels.returns: A list of labels, each with id, name and description.
